PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?investmentGoal ?logic ?scenario (SUM(?cashFlowAmount) AS ?totalCashFlow)
WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?inv (SUM(xsd:decimal(?amt)) AS ?cashFlowAmount)
    WHERE {
      ?cf a wm:CashFlow ;
          wm:cashFlowOfInvestor ?inv ;
          wm:amount ?amt .
    }
    GROUP BY ?inv
  }
  ?inv a wm:Investor .
  ?inv wm:hasInvestmentGoal ?ig .
  ?ig wm:investmentGoal ?investmentGoal .
  ?inv wm:hasRebalancingAction ?ra .
  ?ra wm:hasRebalancingLogic ?logic .
  ?inv wm:hasScenarioRebalancing ?sr .
  ?sr wm:scenario ?scenario .
}
GROUP BY ?investmentGoal ?logic ?scenario
